title: Witness XZ Andromedae Wink
explanation:
# XZ Andromedae: A Cosmic Dance of Shadows

Two stars in the XZ Andromedae system appear to wink at us as they orbit each other nearly edge-on from Earth's perspective, with the dimmer, cooler star regularly blocking the light from its hotter, brighter companion in a cosmic eclipse that repeats like clockwork. Amateur astronomers using specialized software can now track these brightness changes themselves, revealing that this binary pair may actually have two additional stars orbiting around them—a technique so powerful it also helps scientists hunt for distant exoplanets and study some of the universe's most explosive events.
